decisions: Properties owns environments; web properties receive one active primary production environment; primary origin remains mirrored to website_property_configs for compatibility; canonical parsing is admission validation rather than crawler SSRF authorization; public DNS hostnames only in the MVP
risks: Canonical origin admission does not resolve DNS and must not replace per-hop crawler network safety; mirrored website origin remains until downstream consumers migrate to environments
